integrity: The metric and lower-bound arguments are proved for the full parameter intervals; endpoint literature is used only for context and the general upper bounds. Search non-detection is not treated as a proof of novelty.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies attainable optimal quantitative Schur constants in the bounded uniformly discrete class; it does not classify all metrics realizing a fixed constant.
The interpolation deforms two published endpoint constructions, so an equivalent parameter family could exist under different terminology even though none was located.
No independent audit has been performed.
title: Every quantitative Schur constant from \(1\) to \(3\) occurs for a bounded uniformly discrete Lipschitz-free space
